orphans: the decision timeline — dated production decisions in sequence (greenlight scope, engine decision, platform-target change, reboot, staffing ramp, milestone slips)
critical reception — review aggregate, critic consensus, critic/audience divergence, post-patch re-review
shipped build state & team capability — bug/performance state at launch, cut content, stub features, and credits-derived attrition
column_utilisation.note: flows and actors took the material cleanly and are recorded as a contradiction of the orchestrator's hypothesis 1. The failure is not market-shape, it is single-track shape.

time_saved.why: The methodic accelerates the cheap half (retrieval, tension, engine fit) and does nothing for the expensive half (assembling an unpublished production timeline: ~180 of 480 min, 0 saved). Confidence low per accepted-gaps.md scope-note (no runner exists) and SKILL.md:104-106 (L1 reads the prompt charitably).

engine_availability.assessment: A excellent · D good · B good (underrated for the genre) · G good for the derived short · C medium · F poor · E poor. Not zero, not seven — the notebook would have a shape. Strongest layer of the methodic for this domain.

findings.creator: game-postmortem
findings.topic: A big launch underperformed, and every explanation offered is downstream of a production decision made three years earlier
findings.title: mechanisms[].chain steps carry no fact ids — the causal spine is the one structure in the notebook that is unsourced
findings.expected: A mechanism's chain links reference the facts they stand on, like reversals[].evidence[] and conclusions.restsOn do, so the causal claim is evidence-linked and visible to the wound graph.
findings.got: mechanisms[] is {id, name, chain[], explains, needs_analogy, note?} with chain[] an array of free-text strings and no field referencing fact ids. Reversals and conclusions both resolve against the card graph; the mechanism does not. Descoping a fact a mechanism depends on registers no wound because the dependency was never declared.
findings.refuter: Tried 'the topic is just hard': no — every domain's mechanisms are causal claims and every one should be sourced; this bites the incumbent market topic too, visible at notebook.json:202-209 where m-etf-plumbing restates f-etf-lag and f-etf-absorbed in different words with no ids. Tried 'competent execution would have produced it anyway': a competent researcher cannot add a field that does not exist, and NOTEBOOK-SCHEMA.md:92 forbids prose, closing the workaround. Tried 'present-but-missed': grepped the schema and the exemplar; reversals[] has evidence[], conclusions has restsOn, mechanisms has neither. Tried 'lens': a shared-mechanism repair serving all 20 topics is content, not a domain fork.
findings.l2_priority: Produce a mechanism on a temporal topic and check whether the run invents an ad-hoc id convention in note?, and whether the wound graph misses a mechanism when its supporting fact is descoped.

findings.creator: game-postmortem
findings.topic: A big launch underperformed; the cause is a date
findings.title: No temporal ordering primitive — as_of is a staleness field, chain steps carry no time, and the board re-sorts authored chronology into domain buckets
findings.expected: A topic whose argument is a sequence of dated decisions can express 'decision A at T1 constrained option B at T2' and have that order survive to the review surface.
findings.got: as_of is defined as the field that drives currency (freshness), and the exemplar uses it with three different semantics: event date (f-sbr, 2025-03-06), observation date (f-now, 2026-08-10), and a bare year covering three separate events (f-genius, '2026'). chain[] steps have no time field, so array position carries argumentative order that a reader cannot distinguish from temporal order. CARD_DIMENSION then re-buckets every card by column, so a chronologically authored facts[] renders grouped by domain with no date affordance.
findings.refuter: Tried 'the topic is just hard': the field-semantics collision is demonstrated inside the exemplar itself on the topic the schema was derived from, not on mine. Tried 'a researcher could just use as_of as an event date': then currency (expires_first/durable) computes on event dates and a 2019 greenlight reads as the most stale fact in the notebook — the two uses are in direct conflict, not merely underspecified. Tried 'present-but-missed': no ordering field anywhere in NOTEBOOK-SCHEMA.md or RESEARCH-PROMPT.md. Tried 'lens': legislative, conflict-OSINT, fraud-collapse and box-office topics are all temporal, so a shared occurred_at field plus a date affordance on the board serves the cast — content.
findings.l2_priority: CONDITION FOR RE-SCORING TO L1-fail. Author facts[] in strict chronological order on a temporal topic and confirm whether the board renders any date ordering or only column grouping.

findings.creator: game-postmortem
findings.topic: Sales, reception and production as three separable tracks
findings.title: No column for critical reception, so reception cards fall next to sales — automating the genre's standing error
findings.expected: A domain where a product can perform badly and be well made can file reception evidence separately from commercial evidence, so that 'sold badly, reviewed well' is representable as a finding.
findings.got: Seven columns hold no reception dimension. The only column that will accept a review score is 'the number' (purpose: what the price actually did), which already holds sales — and DEFAULT_DIMENSION is 'the-number', so any untagged reception card lands there silently. A strong review average filed under the commercial-performance column reads as evidence about sales.
findings.refuter: Tried 'this is just my topic': the collapse of commercial performance into quality judgement is the named standing error of a whole area (entertainment: game, film box-office, streaming, music all carry it), so reachability is domain-wide, not seat-specific. Tried 'present-but-missed': walked all seven purpose lines; none covers third-party critical judgement of the artefact. Tried 'content': plausibly yes — a renamed/added column is content, not a forked process — but flagged undecided because a reception column may be the concrete deliverable of an entertainment lens rather than a shared eighth column. Judge to rule. Silent-fallback half of this is G-000 and is NOT re-raised.
findings.l2_priority: Confirm where a live run tags review-aggregate facts, and whether it invents an untagged card that hits the default.

findings.creator: game-postmortem
findings.title: The notebook is single-thesis by construction — one tension, one verdict, one question, and seven emptyMeans written in the singular 'the story'
findings.expected: A topic carrying several tracks that are true simultaneously but not established as causally linked can declare them as independent, with the linkage held as a gated inference rather than as a premise.
findings.got: question is singular, verdict is 'the one-sentence answer', tension is one {expectation, reality} object, and a notebook without one is declared a failed notebook. Every dimension emptyMeans reads a missing column as a gap in one argument ('the demand story is unexamined', 'the story has no agents'). Once the tension is written, the other tracks are structurally demoted to evidence for it.
findings.refuter: Partly refuted, deliberately, and this is recorded as a contradiction of the pessimistic reading. The notebook layer DOES hold a conditional link honestly: unknowns[].impact (NOTEBOOK-SCHEMA.md:76-78, rule 5 at :98) plus RESEARCH-PROMPT.md:101 give 'moves with, not because of', and conclusions.ts opt-in asymmetry (:15-17) with restsOn (:45) and mandatory falsifiableBy (:50) is a near-perfect primitive for 'the production trouble caused the sales miss' — off by default, falsifier required, cards named. What fails is the BOARD, which has columns for one track and emptyMeans sentences asserting one story. Severity held at major on the surface half; verdict uncertain because the notebook half passes and the judge must decide whether one-thesis-per-notebook is a defensible philosophy commitment or an artefact of the derivation topic.
findings.l2_priority: Run a topic with two genuinely unlinked tracks and see whether the run manufactures a link to satisfy the single tension field, or reports the non-link in unknowns as designed.

findings.creator: game-postmortem
findings.topic: Third-party sales estimates, self-serving interviews, credits archaeology, leaked schedules
findings.title: confidence conflates transmission-reliability with source interest, and there is no field for a figure's method — while the MEASURED/OBSERVED/INFERRED/ASSUMED ladder the rubric tests is not wired into the research path at all
findings.expected: An evidence class that is reliable as to what was said and unreliable as to what happened can record both; an estimate can state the method that produced it; an inference can state the observations it rests on.
findings.got: facts[] offers a free-string source, confidence in three words, and a load_bearing boolean. There is no method field (so 'panel-modelled, digital excluded' goes in note? or nowhere), no interest/provenance field (so a self-serving post-launch interview and a price print share one confidence scale), and no derived_from (so credits archaeology either launders an inference as a medium-confidence fact — the :108 anti-pattern — or becomes a conclusion, which is correct but leaves it unable to support anything, since nothing can restsOn a conclusion). Separately: the four-rung ladder is the knowledge library's label set for craft claims (knowledge/README.md:36-41, DIRECTOR-DIMENSION.md:9) and appears nowhere in RESEARCH-PROMPT.md or NOTEBOOK-SCHEMA.md. Its INFERRED rung — 'our reasoning across sources, the observations it rests on stated' — is exactly the missing rung, and it is unreachable from a research run.
findings.refuter: Tried 'the ladder has no honest rung for interpretive evidence' (orchestrator hypothesis 2): CONTRADICTED — the rung exists at knowledge/README.md:40 and demands the inferential step be shown. Tried 'so there is no finding': the rung exists in the knowledge library and is not reachable from RESEARCH-PROMPT.md or the schema, so artifact_check is present-but-missed and the finding is a wiring/discoverability gap, not an absence. Tried 'the topic is just hard': RESEARCH-PROMPT.md:100 already handles vendor statistics, proving the authors modelled interested sources — they modelled the commercial case and not the testimonial one. Tried 'note? is enough': env.md:33 rules a field you wanted and could not fill a schema finding, not a workaround. Sub-finding worth the judge's attention: :123's remedy for a low-confidence load-bearing fact is a second source, and in this domain a second source structurally does not exist, so the flag can never be cleared.

findings.creator: game-postmortem
findings.topic: The counter-case is 'it launched fine and expectations were wrong'
findings.title: steel_man is defined against the verdict, never against the premise — and the premise challenge exists only inside one engine's honesty check
findings.expected: A notebook whose strongest counter-argument is 'there is nothing here to explain' can hold that at full strength, engine-independently, since the schema requires the notebook to survive every engine.
findings.got: steel_man is 'the strongest case against the verdict' and the prompt repeats 'against your own verdict'. A premise attack ('the game sold what a game like that sells; the miss is in the forecast') is a different object and has no home. ENGINES.md states the premise challenge correctly as D-honest tell #1, but that is a render-time check inside Engine D — pick Engine A and nothing asks whether the underperformance was real.
findings.refuter: Tried 'present-but-missed, so not a gap': accepted as the artifact_check — the concept IS written down, at ENGINES.md:87-90 — but it is scoped to one engine while NOTEBOOK-SCHEMA.md:91 requires engine-independence, so the finding survives as a placement error rather than an absence. Tried 'the counter-case column covers it': the column is 'the strongest argument that nothing unusual is happening', which is the premise attack — so the BOARD has the right definition and the SCHEMA has the wrong one, and the two disagree with each other. That strengthens the finding. Tried 'lens': a one-line schema rewording plus a prompt line serves every domain whose premise is contestable — content.
findings.l2_priority: Check whether a live run's steel_man attacks the verdict or the premise, and whether an Engine A render ever questions the premise.

findings.creator: game-postmortem
findings.topic: A production timeline where the absence of a causal link is the finding
findings.title: The AND-THEN prohibition cannot express a deliberate non-link — and the exemplar violates its own quality bar twice
findings.expected: A methodic whose senior discipline is 'these two tracks may not be causally connected' can represent temporal adjacency without asserting causation, and the one law can distinguish 'no link found' from 'link forbidden'.
findings.got: The law admits only BUT or THEREFORE; the prompt says an AND-THEN means 'you have a sequence, not a mechanism — either find the missing link or drop it'; the diagnostics say AND-THEN count 'must be zero'. In a production history the most important join is sometimes precisely non-causal — the schedule did not respond to the scope change — and the absence IS the finding. The rule instructs the researcher to invent a link or discard the observation. Both options are wrong. Corroboration that the rule is unworkable even on its home topic: the exemplar's mechanism chains use bare 'AND' twice, in direct violation of the quality bar at RESEARCH-PROMPT.md:124.
findings.refuter: Tried 'the law is about the SCRIPT, not the notebook, so a non-link can live in unknowns': partly right and the severity is held at major rather than blocker for exactly that reason — unknowns[].impact can carry it. But RESEARCH-PROMPT.md Phase 3 applies the law to the NOTEBOOK's mechanisms and instructs 'drop it', which loses the observation before it reaches unknowns. Tried 'the exemplar's bare ANDs are a drafting slip, not evidence': two of three mechanisms contain one, and the quality bar at :124 is a checklist item that was ticked anyway — that is a rule the process does not enforce on itself, which is the definition of present-broken. Tried 'lens': the distinction between 'no link' and 'link forbidden' is needed by every domain that reports a correlation — content, one clause in CRAFT-BASELINE and one in Phase 3.
findings.l2_priority: Count bare AND / AND-THEN joins in a produced notebook's chains and in the rendered script, and check whether any deliberate non-link survived to the script as 'coincided with'.

findings.creator: game-postmortem
findings.topic: A promised feature that was greenlit and never actually built
findings.title: The 'politics' column's label excludes the material its own purpose sentence describes
findings.expected: A column whose purpose is 'what changed, and whether it was actually implemented' accepts any announced-but-unbuilt commitment.
findings.got: The label is 'Politics & regulation' and the emptyMeans is 'Policy is being assumed to work, or assumed not to', so a researcher files only regulatory material there. An announced engine migration, a promised feature that shipped as a stub, a greenlit reboot that was never resourced — the single best fit for the column's stated purpose and the exact material its label turns away. Column scored unused for this topic on the literal reading.
findings.refuter: Tried 'a researcher would read the purpose, not the label': the label is what renders on the board and what the CARD_DIMENSION tagger reasons in; and RESEARCH-PROMPT.md:31's domain row is titled 'Politics / regulation' too, so both surfaces agree on the narrow reading. Tried 'this is my topic being hard': the generalised column — 'commitments made, and whether they were kept' — is the cheapest and highest-yield edit in this report and serves any domain with announcements in it. Explicitly content; the mechanism holds this perfectly once the vocabulary is widened.

findings.creator: game-postmortem
findings.title: actors.emptyMeans pressures naming, and no rule scopes a motive claim to institutions rather than individuals
findings.expected: A methodic with exposure as a first-class concept states who a motive claim may be about, not only how confident it may be.
findings.got: The actors column's emptyMeans reads 'Nobody is named — the story has no agents', which is a nudge to name. The unhinged leap tier is explicitly 'a claim about MOTIVE, the least verifiable kind of claim there is'. The safeguards are real — off by default, mandatory falsifier, UI marking — but they constrain the CONFIDENCE of the claim and say nothing about its SUBJECT. The exemplar's unhinged card attributes motive to an administration and is safe because an administration is not a person; that is luck, not policy.
findings.ceiling: If accepted as by-design, the ceiling is: opt-in + falsifier + UI marking make an unhinged conclusion honest, but nothing prevents it being about a named private individual, and the safeguards do not scale down to a Creator whose exposure class is higher than low-medium.
findings.refuter: On orchestrator hypothesis 3 ('unhinged is unsafe when a conclusion names a living person') I CONTRADICT at my own exposure level: for a low-medium seat naming studios, the falsifier requirement plus opt-in plus the UI mark is adequate, and I would ship behind it. Tried 'so there is no finding': the residue is a naming POLICY, not a safety rail, and it is genuinely absent — but my seat is the wrong one to price it. Verdict uncertain and severity minor deliberately; the fraud and geopolitics seats carry the real version of this and the judge should rank on their evidence, not mine. The emptyMeans nudge is separable, cheap, and confirmed.
findings.l2_priority: Whether a live run's unhinged conclusion attributes motive to a named individual when the domain's actors are individuals.

findings.creator: game-postmortem
findings.topic: Where does the counter-case actually go?
findings.title: Three containers for counter-case material with no routing rule — and the exemplar files its strongest counter in the weakest one
findings.expected: A stated rule for what belongs in steel_man versus counter_positions_to_state_fairly versus the counter-case column, so the strongest opposing argument reliably lands in the mandatory field.
findings.got: The counter-case has a Phase 1 search row, a Phase 6 mandate, a steel_man field, a counter_positions_to_state_fairly[] field and a board column, with no stated relationship between them. In the exemplar the four-year-cycle argument sits in counter_positions_to_state_fairly, while the Adjudication render promotes that same argument to Candidate 1, placed first and explicitly not dismissed. The notebook's strongest counter was in its weaker container and only the engine rescued it.
findings.artifact_check_note: The containers are present; the routing rule between them is confirmed-absent.
findings.refuter: Tried 'the render fixed it, so no harm': it did, on one topic, under one engine, by an author who knew the material — Engine A would have inherited the misfiling, since only D's honesty check goes looking. Tried 'this is my topic': the demonstration is entirely inside the incumbent Bitcoin run; my topic contributed nothing but the question. Severity held at minor because the consequence is misplacement rather than absence, and RESEARCH-PROMPT.md:87-93 does make the steel-man mandatory.

contradictions_of_brief.hypothesis: The seven columns are market-shaped and will collapse or leave orphans on non-market topics.
contradictions_of_brief.ruling: HALF-REFUTED. flows and actors took entertainment/production material cleanly — sell-in vs sell-through is literally a plumbing question and 'does the plumbing behave as people assume' is what a post-mortem is for. macro transfers by analogy. The defect is not market-shape, it is SINGLE-TRACK shape: three orphan groups, all belonging to the two tracks the domain must keep separate from the third.

contradictions_of_brief.hypothesis: The evidence ladder MEASURED/OBSERVED/INFERRED/ASSUMED has no honest rung for interpretive or practitioner-consensus evidence.
contradictions_of_brief.ruling: REFUTED TWICE, IN OPPOSITE DIRECTIONS. The rung exists — INFERRED at knowledge/README.md:40, which even requires the observations it rests on be stated. And the ladder is not in the research path at all: it is the knowledge library's craft-claim label set (DIRECTOR-DIMENSION.md:9), while notebook facts carry confidence: high|medium|low (NOTEBOOK-SCHEMA.md:46-47). The gap is wiring, not vocabulary. Recorded as G-GP-05.

contradictions_of_brief.hypothesis: The unhinged leap tier is unsafe when a conclusion names a living person.
contradictions_of_brief.ruling: CONTRADICTED AT THIS EXPOSURE LEVEL. Opt-in asymmetry + mandatory falsifier + UI marking is adequate for a low-medium seat naming studios. The genuine residue is the absence of a naming POLICY (subject of the claim) as opposed to a confidence rail. Recorded as G-GP-09, severity minor, verdict uncertain — the fraud and geopolitics seats should price this, not this one.

contradictions_of_brief.hypothesis: Phase 1's mandatory counter-case row is unsatisfiable for topics with no literature.
contradictions_of_brief.ruling: REFUTED FOR THIS TOPIC. 'It launched fine and expectations were wrong' has abundant same-week literature and is additionally an accounting argument statable from figures already collected, with no extra search. This is not the hostile seat for that hypothesis. The real counter-case defect here is shape, not reachability — see G-GP-06.
